title: Sukhatme Fixed Points and the Terminal Poisson Process
abstract: For the singular Luce profile with rates n,n-1,...,1, this paper proves that the expected number of fixed points is asymptotic to e^{-1} log n, establishes a local Poisson point process for fixed points on logarithmic terminal coordinates, and proves all fixed factorial-moment asymptotics. The proof develops an anisotropic terminal saddle, tilted lattice local estimates, product-scale localization, and a death-process domination for non-separated configurations.

blocks.end: Theorem \ref{thm:suk-fact} proves the fixed-order factorial moments

# Mechanical extraction record: Sukhatme fixed points

Date: 12 October 2026.

This record covers only the mechanical extraction of the Sukhatme fixed-point theorem package from the frozen 139-page manuscript. It is not a correctness audit, novelty review, or formal verification.

The standalone manuscript contains the exact archived exponential/Gumbel and lattice-LLT inputs, death-process bound, one-point saddle, separated anisotropic joint estimate, local terminal Poisson point-process theorem, and full fixed-factorial-moment theorem. All {THEOREMS} theorem-like environments, {LABELS} labels, and {REFS} internal reference targets are present and closed. No active manuscript is a proof dependency.

The extraction does not assess the Fourier concentration lemmas, anisotropic tilting, product-scale localization, covariance stability, factorial-moment summation, or vague-topology passage. A separate adversarial audit is required.
